## Benefits for Employees in USA

Employees with outstanding contributions are eligible to

earn a cash award from the CEO every quarter.

#### Health Insurance

We offer multiple medical plan options for employees, spouses/domestic partners, and children. We also offer disability insurance.

#### Unlimited Time Off

We encourage everyone to recharge their batteries with a flexible Time Off Policy.

#### Flexible Spending Accounts

We offer FSA for you to set aside pre-tax money from your paycheck for health care or dependent care expenses. You can contribute up to $7,600 per calendar year.

#### Life Insurance

We offer the same amount as your salary, or up to a maximum of $100,000.

#### 401k+ and Provident Fund

We offer both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans.

#### Referral Bonus

We offer a generous referral bonus for every candidate who gets hired based on internal employee referrals.

## Benefits for Employees in India

Employees with outstanding contributions are eligible to

earn a cash award from the CEO every quarter.

#### Leave Policy

21 earned Leaves/year and 12 Sick Leaves/year

26 weeks Maternity Leave to eligible women employees. Employees may take Paternity Leave up to 5 days off with pay upon the birth of their child.

#### Medical Insurance

100% premium paid by Aviso Software India LLP. Maximum of INR 5,00,000 per policy period for Employee+Family

Maternity benefit up to INR 50,000 per childbirth.

#### Education Reimbursement

Reimbursement of certification fees up to maximum of INR 2,50,000.

Reimbursement of professional training fees up to maximum of INR 75,000 per year.

#### Employee Referral Policy

A referral bonus of up to INR 1,50,000 will be paid to employees per eligible referral.

#### Meal Coupons

Monthly allotment of INR 2,500 worth Sodexo meal coupons.

#### Gratuity

15 days basic salary per year of completed service, eligible after 5 years of continuous service, fully paid by Aviso.
